title: OpenreStreamWriteResult
description: openre.stream-write-result@1: answers of openre.stream.write on OpenRe.Stream. POST /api/v1/streams → 201 { stream, key } where key is the first ingest key, shown once (Cache-Control no-store); PATCH /api/v1/streams/:id → { stream }; DELETE /api/v1/streams/:id → 204 with no body.

key.description: The plain ingest key: only in this answer.
